name: Sona UI
summary: Shadcn registry of animated React components: tabs, dropdowns, dialogs, buttons, text effects and shader backgrounds.
description: A source-owned React component library distributed as a shadcn registry: each component installs with npx shadcn@latest add @sona-ui/<name> and lives in your project as editable TypeScript. It covers animated tabs, dropdowns, dialogs, switches, checkboxes, buttons, sliders, tooltips, text effects, shader backgrounds, media and activity surfaces, plus shared sona-utils, sona-motion and sona-theme foundations and an agent skill.
contains: components install as source with npx shadcn@latest add @sona-ui/...
animated tabs, dropdown, dialog, switch, checkbox, buttons, slider, tooltip, accordion
text effects: marquee, spinning text, stagger text, split text
shared sona-utils, sona-motion and sona-theme foundations
agent skill, manifest and JSON catalog for AI agents
MIT licensed; built for React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4
